differences: The paper reports the table ages of the 20 older adults as 74.22 +/- 8.11 years; the ages printed in its Table 1 give 73.75 +/- 8.12, and the patients' Table 2 ages give 49.8 +/- 13.9 against 49.88 +/- 12.55 printed in the text, so these were not used as checks.

The paper says 5886 reaching movements were performed by 17 participants; the deposit's 5886 rows come from all 20 participants (17 with complete data). The 280 reaches without a movement onset also count all 20 (250 in the 17).

The paper's counts of extreme outliers removed per metric (for example 140 for normalized duration) were not reproduced with a Q1 - 3 IQR / Q3 + 3 IQR rule per participant or per participant and display, so no outlier flag is given.
